items.briefing:
None of today's articles contain cyber security news directly relevant to Australian organisations or individuals. The most closely related item notes that OpenAI has launched a Computer History feature in ChatGPT for macOS, which stores your chat history locally on your device — something worth being aware of if you use ChatGPT on a work Mac, as saved history could expose sensitive conversations.

**Practical tip:** If you use ChatGPT on a work device, check your privacy settings and consider turning off chat history to avoid storing sensitive work information locally or on OpenAI's servers.
